i18n/catalog#

Message catalogs: translated text looked up by key, with plural forms.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let unread = MessageKey(context: "", identity: "unread");
let russian = MessageCatalog(locale: Locale("ru"), entries: [
    SingularMessage(key: MessageKey(context: "menu", identity: "Open"), text: "Открыть"),
    PluralMessage(key: unread, forms: [
        PluralForm(category: PluralCategory.one, text: "непрочитанное письмо"),
        PluralForm(category: PluralCategory.few, text: "непрочитанных письма"),
        PluralForm(category: PluralCategory.many, text: "непрочитанных писем"),
        PluralForm(category: PluralCategory.other, text: "непрочитанного письма"),
    ]),
]);
russian.plural(unread, PluralNumber("21"));            // "непрочитанное письмо"
FallbackTranslation(primary: russian, fallback: english);

Description#

Message catalogs: translated text looked up by key, with plural forms.

A key is a context and an identity, so one English word can carry several meanings. A plural message has one form per CLDR category of the locale and always an other. Catalogs hold at most 4096 entries.
